note: Model milestones published as meta.model_history (docs/static-api.md). Committed with the code: the database records which model scored each prediction, not when a model was adopted or a display rule changed. Add an entry with every production switch in src/shots/config.py (same date as the adoption report). route: all | odds | noodds | cross_border.

milestones.label: Live record starts
milestones.detail: Negative binomial model, recalibrated per competition, on both routes. Every pick is saved before kick-off from here on.

milestones.label: European cups added (experimental)
milestones.detail: Champions League first, then Europa and Conference League, built from domestic form. Kept out of the official record.

milestones.label: fin_c adopted (no-odds route)
milestones.detail: Opponent-adjusted ratings, head-to-head, season context and per-competition dispersion for fixtures without odds.

milestones.label: Expected total = median of the curve
milestones.detail: The published expected total is now the median of the published curve.

milestones.label: Surge adopted (odds route)
milestones.detail: Production model plus an out-of-sample correction of the total. Scotland Championship stays on negbin_pit_comp.
